images.filename: Brian Stelter at LBJ Foundation and More Perfect hosted a two-day conference, Trust News Democracy at the Lyndon Baines Johnson Library and Museum on 10 April 2024 (cropped).jpg
images.caption:
Brian Stelter
The LBJ Foundation and More Perfect hosted a two-day conference, Trust. News. Democracy., on April 9-10, 2024, at the LBJ Presidential Library in Austin, Texas. The program explored the challenges facing our media landscape and focused on solutions that will allow for a healthier news and information ecosystem—and a stronger nation.  
LBJ Library photo by Jay Godwin 

04/09/2024

images.caption:
Ruthie Foster and the Huston-Tillotson University Concert Choir perform at the LBJ Presidential Library in Austin, Texas, on Monday, July 29, 2024, to commemorate the 60th Anniversary of the Civil Rights Act. After her performance, President Joe Biden delivered the keynote address to honor the historic civil rights law.
